title: Unlock your calls
body: Use the passkey you created for AskCalls.
bodyNoPasskey: Use your passphrase or your recovery code.
lost: Without a passkey or recovery code, calls can't be recovered. <link>Options</link>

rc.title: Enter your recovery code
rc.wrong: Wrong code. Check each group and try again.

passkeyFailed: Couldn't unlock with this passkey. Try again or use your recovery code.
offline: You're offline. Unlocking needs a connection to fetch your keys.

signOutConfirm.title: Sign out of AskCalls?
signOutConfirm.body: Signing out also removes this device's saved keys. You'll need your passkey or recovery code to unlock again.
